This Egyptian cross-sectional study assessed 111 multidrug-resistant and carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae, Acinetobacter baumannii, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates from 2020 to 2021 during the COVID-19 pandemic. Carbapenem resistance was extremely high at 98.2%. Among Klebsiella isolates, 23.9% were colistin resistant, although no mcr genes were detected. blaNDM and blaOXA-48-like
